Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 2, Verse 55

“The Blessed Lord said: When a person abandons all the desires that enter the mind, Partha, and is content within the self by the self, that one is called steady in wisdom.”

Krishna answers the outer question with an inner criterion, then spends the rest of the chapter on the behaviour Arjuna actually asked about. This contentment has no external supplier.
